content.short: VAULT3 is a token-gating and data-gating solution on Cardano for exclusive digital and physical drops.
content.description: VAULT3 is a comprehensive token-gating infrastructure built on the Cardano blockchain, designed to empower creators and projects. The platform allows users to instantly launch custom token gates, using Cardano native assets like NFTs and FTs as 'keys' to distribute exclusive digital content or physical products. With customizable access rules based on Policy IDs, stake pools, or wallet whitelists, VAULT3 enhances the real-world utility of digital assets. By providing a secure and transparent framework for managing drops, VAULT3 helps communities grow and engage in the decentralized economy.
content.meta: VAULT3 is a Cardano token-gating solution for exclusive digital content and physical product drops. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
